notes: Source: /workspace/rate-vault-wr-b1/Wood_River_B1_latest.xlsx (TM face banners WOODRIVER … TM). Prefer this file over RRFF sister for dropdown lists/validations.
openpyxl warns 'Data Validation extension is not supported'; classic DV nodes are stubs (#N/A / empty). Real lists are in x14:dataValidations pointing at Drop Down List and Master Position List.
Drop Down List sheet dimension A1:E51. Column C locations extend through C51; DV ranges sometimes oversized (C2:C65, D1:D20, B1:B5) beyond populated cells.
Named ranges used in rate building: Craft_Type, RateClass, Subcategory (per craft sheet); Master_Position_List. FilterDatabase/Print_Area/Print_Titles are layout-only.

Rate $/ %/Varies is NOT a three-item dropdown list in Drop Down List. Mode is chosen by entering currency-formatted $, percent-formatted %, or the literal text Varies in row 6. Catalogued as three options because the row label and formulas encode exactly those three behaviors.
Strings 'hours worked', 'hours paid', and 'accrual' do NOT appear anywhere in sharedStrings of this workbook.
Shared string '% of BW' appears only as Rate Detail!AC1 column header — not a craft-sheet fringe dropdown option.
Mult is a computed column (Billable Rate / SUM(BaseWage components)), not a selectable option.

Union craft/staff Fringes Subtotal is pulled from Rate Input (Fringe ST/OT/DT columns) via INDEX/MATCH; ST/OT/DT ride behavior for that subtotal is baked into Rate Input values, while Ins/Misc/Pay Tax/O/H/Profit use row-7 selectors on the hall sheet.
ST/OT/DT Calc formula summary (OT/DT rows): ST→copy ST amt; OT→OT=1.5×, DT=1.5×; DT→OT=1.5×, DT=2×; ST-ONLY→OT/DT=0; OT-ONLY→OT=1.5×, ST/DT=0.
